name: Tomb Weed
summary: At Balnir Farmstead, Holland's altered doom weed has drawn the Scourge. The crop now bears the name tomb weed, and Holland wants it for his experiments.

sections.title: Holland's Cultivation
sections.body: Junior Apothecary Holland seeks more than a place in the Royal Apothecary Society. He gathers doom weed, alters it through alchemy, then plants it again in Balnir Farmstead's soil. From that work comes a new strain: tomb weed. Holland sees it as the heart of his experiments and a path to the future he wants for himself.

sections.title: Unintended Attraction
sections.body: Holland expected his altered plants to grow stronger in alchemical use. Instead, the Scourge wandering Balnir Farmstead have taken an interest in them. Now he relies on travelers to get past the undead and gather the mature crop, so his experiments can go on.

faq.answer: Junior Apothecary Holland made tomb weed by altering doom weed through alchemy. He plants the treated herb in Balnir Farmstead's blighted soil.

Junior Apothecary Holland belongs to the Royal Apothecary Society and works in Tirisfal Glades. Ambitious and often frustrated by assistants such as the abomination Gordo, he pursues private plant and alchemical experiments to improve his standing.
Holland grows his altered crop at Balnir Farmstead, an abandoned estate in eastern Tirisfal Glades that has fallen into blight and ruin.

faq.q: Why are the Scourge attracted to tomb weed?
faq.answer: Holland has seen the mindless Scourge at Balnir Farmstead drawn to the altered plant. He does not know why and finds their interest curious.

faq.q: How does tomb weed differ from normal doom weed?
faq.answer: Doom weed grows naturally near the mass gravesite north of the Brill graveyard. Holland alters doom weed through alchemy, then replants it in farmstead soil to make tomb weed.

faq.q: Who is Gordo mentioned by Holland?
faq.answer: Gordo is a wandering abomination created by the Forsaken who roams the roads of Tirisfal Glades. Holland often gives him simple tasks, but Gordo's sluggish mind makes them difficult.

angles.text: As an Undead, you can see Holland's work as part of the Forsaken apothecaries' effort to reshape Tirisfal's blighted plants for alchemy.
As a herbalist, you know alchemical treatment can change a blighted herb such as doom weed, along with its behavior.
